title: Andrei Tarkovsky
idiom: Gorey ink with Russian constructivist texture — stark crosshatched ink on aged paper, camera-less, evoking weight and slow time
hero_prompt: Wide 12:5 landscape, darkened muted sepia-ink field. A single large hourglass filled not with sand but with slow-moving water, each drop suspended mid-fall in a long unbroken chain — the water is time being sculpted. A solitary figure stands at one side, small against the glass, arms outstretched in the gesture of a sculptor before marble. Behind them, the faint ghost of a film-reel frame dissolves into the water. Edward Gorey crosshatch ink style on aged paper, no colour, deep blacks and pale ground. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold square emblem, high contrast black on off-white. A simplified hourglass whose bulbs are replaced by a film frame top and a water droplet bottom, the neck impossibly narrow — one thick ink stroke each. No fine linework, no gradients, fully legible at 24px. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
